data.description: LiquidFun 是 Box2D 的扩展。它为 Box2D 的刚体功能添加了基于粒子的流体和软体模拟。LiquidFun 可以为许多不同的系统构建，包括 Android，iOS，Windows，OS X，Linux 和 JavaScript。
data.label: LiquidFun

data.description: LiquidFun is an extension of Box2D. It adds particle-based fluid and soft-body simulation to Box2D's rigid body capabilities. LiquidFun can be built for many different systems, including Android, iOS, Windows, OS X, Linux, and JavaScript.
data.label: LiquidFun
